units.source_text: 在她还是雏妓时就替她赎身的那个人死后，她刚回到港市，就马上发生了这样的事。

en.t: After the man who had bought her freedom while she was still an apprentice geisha died, she had barely returned to the port city when something like this happened.

units.source_text: 驹子说，打开始到如今，她就讨厌那个人，同他总是有隔阂。

en.t: Komako said that from the very beginning until now she had disliked that man and had always kept a distance from him.
